faqs.q: How accurate is screenshot OCR?
faqs.a: Accuracy is best on sharp, high-contrast text. Blurry screenshots, stylized fonts, or dense UI chrome may need light manual fixes.

faqs.q: Is the screenshot to text tool free?
faqs.a: Yes. It is free on Zetawala. OCR uses open-source libraries on our local server—no paid OCR or AI APIs.

faqs.q: What output formats are available?
faqs.a: You can typically copy recognized text and export as TXT or Markdown depending on the tool options.

faqs.q: Which languages are supported?
faqs.a: Support follows the open-source OCR engine configuration. Latin-script UI screenshots usually work well; check results for other scripts.

faqs.q: Is my screenshot sent to a paid cloud OCR service?
faqs.a: No. Processing stays on Zetawala’s local open-source server path without paid third-party OCR APIs.

faqs.q: Who should use screenshot to text OCR?
faqs.a: Support agents, developers, students, and writers who need editable text from images without typing it by hand.
